<function name="Update" parent="PathFollower" type="classfunc">
	<description>Move the bot along the path.
    <note>player nextbots require <page>CUserCmd:SetForwardMove</page> to move forward along the path</note>
    </description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="bot" type="NextBot">The bot to update along the path. This can also be a nextbot player (<page>player.CreateNextbot</page>)</arg>
	</args>
</function>
